ecuparam.name: DKmode Throttle Plate Opening Angle B024
ecuparam.desc: E7501-RAM 0xFFFFB024 conditioned throttle (input of OEM Delta TPS 0x171C6). Same address as E38. Research parameter.

ecuparam.name: DKmode Delta TPS B028
ecuparam.desc: E7502-RAM 0xFFFFB028 = B024[n]-B024[n-2], updated once per task-9 run. Same address as E54. Research parameter.

ecuparam.name: DKmode Tip-in Enrichment B80C
ecuparam.desc: E7503-RAM 0xFFFFB80C last calculated Tip-in amount (latched, not cleared). Unit microseconds per v72. Same address as E55.

ecuparam.name: DKmode Tip-in Cumulative Delta B814
ecuparam.desc: E7504-RAM 0xFFFFB814 accumulated Delta TPS of the current Tip-in series (limit ROM 0x58DAC). Research parameter.

ecuparam.name: DKmode Injector Latency B8D8
ecuparam.desc: E7505-RAM 0xFFFFB8D8 injector latency (microseconds) = RAM 0xFFFF91E0 * 0.25. Same address as E50.

ecuparam.name: DKmode Tip-in Event Count B818
ecuparam.desc: E7506-RAM 0xFFFFB818 uint8 Tip-in events in current series (limit ROM 0x58852, saturates 255). Research parameter.

ecuparam.name: DKmode Task9 Runs Since Tip-in B821
ecuparam.desc: E7507-RAM 0xFFFFB821 uint8 task-9 runs since last Tip-in event (saturates 255; reset thresholds ROM 0x58853/0x58854). Research parameter.

ecuparam.name: DKmode Task9 Lost Activations 94E4
ecuparam.desc: E7508-RAM 0xFFFF94E4 uint8 count of rejected ActivateTask(9) (E_OS_LIMIT), saturates 255. Research parameter.

ecuparam.name: DKmode CMT1 Half-Tick Counter 94F0
ecuparam.desc: E7509-RAM 0xFFFF94F0 uint16 big-endian, +1 every 2 CMT1 ticks, wraps at 65536. Expected 500/s if Pphi=20 MHz. Two bytes may be read non-atomically. Research parameter.

ecuparam.name: DKmode Tip-in Applied Amount B810
ecuparam.desc: E7510-RAM 0xFFFFB810 amount actually sent to the injector path at the last Tip-in event (us). B80C is written even when the amount threshold blocks; B810 only when fired. Research parameter.
